title: Weak continuity of Jacobian minors of scalar Lipschitz rows under uniform convergence with bounded Lipschitz constants; the induction P(r) (supplied steps 2 and 7)
statement: Let k, r ∈ ℕ and L ∈ ℝ≥0. For j ∈ ℕ and c ∈ Fin r let g^j_c, g_c : ℝ^k → ℝ be L-Lipschitz, with g^j_c → g_c uniformly on ℝ^k as j → ∞ for every c. Let V_b ∈ ℝ^k (b ∈ Fin r), and let φ : ℝ^k → ℝ be Lebesgue integrable. Here ℝ^k = Euclid k carries Lebesgue measure λ, and Dg(x) := fderiv ℝ g x is the zero map at points where g is not differentiable. Then ∫ φ(x)·det(Dg^j_c(x)V_b)_{c,b ∈ Fin r} dλ(x) → ∫ φ(x)·det(Dg_c(x)V_b)_{c,b ∈ Fin r} dλ(x) as j → ∞ (row c, column b).
lean_statement: ∀ (k r : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (gs : ℕ → Fin r → Euclid k → ℝ) (g : Fin r → Euclid k → ℝ) (V : Fin r → Euclid k) (φ : Euclid k → ℝ), Integrable φ → (∀ j c, LipschitzWith L (gs j c)) → (∀ c, LipschitzWith L (g c)) → (∀ c, TendstoUniformly (fun j => gs j c) (g c) atTop) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, φ x * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => fderiv ℝ (gs j c) x (V b))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, φ x * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun c b => fderiv ℝ (g c) x (V b))))
